data.name: Noa
data.gender_notes: Noa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word ‘noah’ meaning rest, comfort, or peace. In the Old Testament, Noa was the name of a woman who, along with her husband, was saved from the Great Flood. Her name is also mentioned in the New Testament as a descendant of Jesus. The name Noa carries the meaning “Rest, Comfort, Peace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Noa usually hope their child will grow to embody rest, comfort, peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of hope and renewal after a great adversity.
data.etymology: Noa belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rest, Comfort, Peace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Noa holds significance in Jewish culture as it is associated with one of the most famous figures in Jewish history, Noah, who is revered for his righteousness and obedience to God. In other cultures and communities, Noa is also used as a given name and remains popular due to its meaning of comfort and peace.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Noa holds great spiritual significance as it is a reminder of God's mercy, protection, and provision. It is a name that inspires faith, hope, and trust in the face of adversity, as demonstrated by the story of Noah's Ark. Additionally, it is a name that can serve as a reminder of God's promise to always be present with His people, offering comfort and rest in times of need.
